title: Transport of the intrinsic direct-image comparisons through a fixed mate
statement: For finite coefficients and composable scheme maps, the two normalized derived direct-image comparisons followed by any fixed-scalar conjugate agree with the corresponding transported mate coordinate.

source.place: The comparison-square naturality substep of the intrinsic direct compositor normalization.

proof.text: Use naturality of the section-normalized derived direct-image comparisons, then cancel the equivalence unit and counit in the transported adjunction square.

proof_origin.place: Comparison transport isolated from the fixed compositor target.

mathlib_searches.results: No direct match; project-specific statement retained.

from.place: Naturality portion of the abstract mate-pasting step.
